architecture: External LLM -> bounded host/persistent SessionStore -> BCLClient over authenticated loopback TLS -> BCLGateway/BCLJobs/AgentRuntime -> native Minecraft. Host validates, budgets and persists; it does not select gameplay goals or generate action sequences.

decisions.note: The spruce forest offers nearby timber. I’ll gather a small supply first, then choose a safe spot for a workshop and shelter.
The first timber targets lacked a reachable route. I’ll move along observed safe ground to inspect the closer spruce from another side.
The spruce log is now directly exposed beside supported ground. I’ll try gathering timber from this closer position.
The mining attempt made no progress at point-blank range. I’ll try a clear, supported stance farther from the trunk and harvest just one log.
The first log is secured. I’ll make a workbench and collect another exposed log for tools.
The workbench is crafted. Mining from immediately beside the trunk stalled, so I’ll try an offset eastern stance with more clearance.
This trunk has repeatedly resisted harvesting. I’ll explore the nearby supported ground for easier timber and a practical home site.
There is another exposed spruce trunk east of me. I’ll approach over the observed level ground and try collecting timber there.
Leaves obstruct the western approach. I’ll inspect the trunk from its accessible southern side and try harvesting the lower exposed wood.
A different trunk is now directly exposed. I’ll harvest from a clear, slightly offset stance and check whether wood is actually collected.
Timber harvesting is repeatedly failing. I’ll establish a small workbench site on the observed level ground, then inspect nearby terrain for a modest shelter.
The workbench is placed. I’ll test collecting exposed soil beside the slope for a small shelter without disturbing my footing.

limitations: One short Peaceful campaign, no hostile-mob or long-term qualification
No shelter, persistent home, tools, stone, food production or storage established
Repeated native mining failures exhausted budget; no precise root cause established
Replay GUI/camera smoke and campaign playback scoped, not every visual interaction audited

model.decider: Existing CommandJSONDecider with explicitly selected installed pi CLI
model.knowledge: Actual BCL registry and existing structured native recipe catalogue
model.primary_instruction:
You are playing Minecraft Survival in a new world.
Your objective is to survive, establish a useful home and gradually develop your world.
You decide what to do, what to build, which resources to collect and how to organize your work.
Use the available Blockwire capabilities to interact with Minecraft.
Observe the results of your actions and change your plans when necessary.
Do not claim success unless the actual world state confirms it.
You do not need to defeat the Ender Dragon.
Start by examining your surroundings and deciding what would be useful to do first.

outcomes.failure_root_cause: Reach/route rejection and mining postcondition timeouts observed. Precise native mining cause not established; no fabricated fix or attribution.
outcomes.useful_progress: Self-selected exploration, resource acquisition, crafting and one-block workshop infrastructure; not a completed Survival base.

persistence.future_continuation: Explicit fresh actor rebind/new activation; revalidate existing memory/world; never replay pending or old frames.

replay.free_camera: Viewer offers free-camera and recorded-player spectator controls; no cinematic qualification
replay.initial_active_check: ReplayMod auto-recording smoke-qualified, per-world staging directory present before first BCL action; growing actual packet stream confirmed during campaign. Initial staging directory size was not a replay-file size.
replay.interval: Recording starts at world join, before first autonomous action, ends after native save/quit. Pause-adjusted duration 499.816 s covers 498.212 s bounded agent interval; not an exact wall-clock video timestamp or proof of every rendered frame.
replay.playback_scope: Original campaign archive selected by world/name, opened in real ReplayMod viewer, played and inspected in early/later world views; recorded-player overview and recipe-unlock toast observed. Not every action/GUI visually audited.
